question: How many sellers are based in the state of RJ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ';

question: What is the average freight value per order item?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_freight FROM order_items;

question: How many orders have the status canceled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';

question: Which 5 cities have the most unique customers?
sql: SELECT customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each payment type, how many payments were made in more than one installment?
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payments FROM order_payments WHERE payment_installments > 1 GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payments DESC;

question: What is the average review score for orders delivered late compared with orders delivered on time?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date::date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on time' END AS delivery, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: Which 5 product categories (in English) have the highest total freight value?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_freight FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_freight DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which month of 2017 had the most orders?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many sellers have sold at least 100 items?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers FROM (SELECT seller_id FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) s;

question: For each customer state, what percentage of payments were made by boleto?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'boleto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_boleto FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY pct_boleto DESC;

question: How many products have no category?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL;

question: On average, how many items does an order contain?
sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS avg_items FROM order_items;

question: Which 3 states have the most sellers?
sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS sellers FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY sellers DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which 5 customer states have the longest average delivery time in days?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp - o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_days DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1) x;

question: What percentage of total payment value comes from each payment type?
sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND((100.0 * SUM(payment_value) / SUM(SUM(payment_value)) OVER ())::numeric, 2) AS pct_value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY pct_value DESC;

question: For each month of 2018, how many orders were placed and what was the change from the previous month?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, orders, orders - LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change FROM m ORDER BY month;

question: Who is the top seller by revenue in each of the states SP, RJ and MG?
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT se.seller_state, oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers se ON oi.seller_id = se.seller_id WHERE se.seller_state IN ('SP', 'RJ', 'MG') GROUP BY se.seller_state, oi.seller_id), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_state ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT seller_state, seller_id, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY seller_state;

question: Out of all orders that have a review, what percentage received a 1-star review?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN review_score = 1 THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS pct_1_star FROM order_reviews;

question: For the 5 categories with the most products, what is the average product weight in grams?
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, ROUND(AVG(p.product_weight_g)::numeric, 2) AS avg_weight_g FROM products p JOIN top ON p.product_category_name = top.product_category_name LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_weight_g DESC;
